text:
The Mexican flag

—green, white, and red—

in its colors shelters

the Homeland in sovereign bloom.

When in our hands we hold

our flag,

it is like holding whole

water, ships, light, and oars.


When we raise its colors,

our heart feels

the joy of a song

that pours itself out in flowers.


For love of my flag,

I call everyone "brother."

Whoever carries it in hand

carries peace wherever he wishes.


Peace, work, love, and faith

are the sky of my flag.

I want, as all my longing,

to stand worthily at its foot.

translation.title: The Mexican Flag
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the civic hymn tone and the flag as vessel of peace, work, love, and faith.
